title: Netflix Locks Down Release Date for Major 2027 Exclusive – Watch New Trailer
content:
Netflix has acquired the exclusive streaming rights to one of the most enigmatic power fantasies and love stories, beginning in January 2027. The giant streaming platform has gained significant access to the anime world over the past few years, bringing many popular anime to its platform. At the same time, Netflix has also secured the rights to several exclusive anime. 2027 looks set to continue this trend, with one of the latest Winter 2027 anime joining another exclusive, Sakamoto Days , being Bride of the Barrier Master .

The anime was first announced in August 2025, with a Winter 2027 release window. Now, with the Winter season fast approaching, its release date has finally been revealed, with the series arriving exclusively on Netflix on January 6. It is an exciting announcement, as the romantic fantasy manga and light novel series has built a dedicated fan base eager to see its vibrant world brought to life through an anime adaptation and experience its romantic banter. The staff behind the anime’s production and the latest teaser have also offered promising signs of what Netflix’s exclusive title has in store.

Netflix’s Biggest Romantic Fantasy Anime of 2027 Begins Streaming This January

Bride of the Barrier Master is being animated by Troyca, with Toru Kitahata serving as the director. The production also features Akari Kito as the female lead, Hana Ichise, who is known for several roles, including Nezuko in Demon Slayer and Hina Chono in Blue Box , another Netflix exclusive in international regions. Meanwhile, the male lead, Saku Ichinomiya, will be voiced by Kikunosuke Toya, another renowned voice actor in the anime industry, best known for roles such as Denji. His casting makes him a perfect fit for Saku, a rowdy character who likes to take charge.

While the production committee looks promising, with the latest visuals and teasers making the anime shine, the series’ narrative is what will make it stand out even more. The fantasy series follows a neglected girl named Hana Ichise, who is believed to lack the power required of one of the protectors of the pillars that safeguard Japan. She is constantly overshadowed by her older twin sister, who possesses the necessary power and fulfills her duties. However, Hana secretly possesses immense power but refuses to use it because she wants to live a normal life. Unfortunately, fate has other plans, as her secret is eventually discovered by the young head of the clan, Saku Ichinomiya.

Saku initially pressures Hana into marrying him, which she naturally refuses. However, she is eventually forced into the marriage, as she has no other options. Thus begins Hana’s new life, as her desire to live peacefully despite possessing immense power is disrupted by her marriage to the head of the clan. This adds a romantic twist to her journey, promising a series of hilarious moments and an unconventional love story that fans can immerse themselves in. Netflix has a reputation for featuring a variety of anime , and Bride of the Barrier Master ‘s exclusivity adds another unique title to its catalogue. It could even emerge as the platform’s biggest romantic fantasy anime of 2027.

title: Disney Villains Anime Releases New Season 2 Trailer Ahead of Disney+ Debut – Watch Now
content:
Disney’s classic roster of villains have been taking over the anime world in a wild new kind of way, and now fans have gotten a much better look at its Season 2 return with the first full trailer helping to show it all off. Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation has been a notable mobile game release where classic Disney Villains get new anime makeovers , and the first season of its official anime adaptation made its debut last year. Now it’s coming back for a new season with a new arc on Disney+ next month.

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation Season 2 will be hitting Disney+ on December 23rd, and with it is going to be adapting the Episode of Savanaclaw from the game. Much like how the first season had a school inspired by the Queen of Hearts from Alice in Wonderland , this next season is inspired by Scar from The Lion King . You can check out the new trailer for the coming season below to get an idea of what to expect.

Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2 Drops New Trailer for Disney+ Premiere

Officially titled as Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ , the second season of the series will be making its debut with Disney+ in Japan on December 23rd . International release plans for the anime have yet to be announced as of this time, but it will likely be available for streaming with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ in the United States when it makes its debut much like the first season. It will be running for eight episodes in total, and has also confirmed that new episodes will be releasing on a weekly basis.

Takahiro Natori returns from the first season to serve as chief director and script supervisor for Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ while Shin Katagai serves as director for Yumeta Company and Graphinica. Yoichi Kato provides the scripts for the series, Hanaka Nakano and Akane Sato provide the character designs, and Takumi Ozawa returns from the original mobile game release to compose the music. But it’s heading into an entirely different arc with the focus on a different school than seen in the first season.

What’s New for Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2?

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation was originally announced with a three arc adaptation with the intent of adapting the Episode of Heartslabyul (as seen with the first season), Episode of Savanaclaw (as seen in this new season), and Episode of Octavinelle arcs from the mobile game release. The main voice cast from the first season are set to reprise their respective roles, but there will be more of a focus on the Savanaclaw students seen prior such as Yuichiro Umehara as Leona Kingscholar, Taito Ban as Jack Howl, and Aoi Ichikawa as Ruggie Bucchi.

There will be a new main protagonist at the center of the second season too with Fairouz Ai as Yuuka Hirasaka, a Judo student who ends up whisked away to this titular wonderland. So it’s got an extra bit of fun for those Isekai fans hoping to scratch that kind of anime itch as well along with adding that bump from Disney icons. But how are you liking Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Twisted-Wonderland: Episode of Savanaclaw Anime's New Video Unveils Ending Song
content:
Disney+ Japan started streaming the "payoff promotional video" for Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw , the second season for the Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation series , on Tuesday. The video announces and previews the ending theme song "DIADEM" performed by the members of the Savanaclaw dormitory. "Piece of my world" by the Night Ravens will continue to be the anime's opening theme song from the first season.

The voices of Savanaclaw dorm members from the first season include:

• Yūichirō Umehara as Leona Kingscholar

• Taito Ban as Jack Howl

• Aoi Ichikawa as Ruggie Bucchi

The new season will premiere exclusively on Disney+ on December 23, and will have eight episodes.

The original Disney Twisted-Wonderland smartphone game's story begins when the main character is summoned to another world by a magic mirror. There, the main character arrives at the prestigious magic training school Night Raven College. With nowhere to go, the main character is offered protection by the school's masked headmaster, and gets to know the uncooperative but genius students of the school while trying to find a way to get back home.

Episode of Heartslabyul , the first eight-episode season, debuted exclusively on Disney+ in October 2025, and the overall anime will run for three seasons. The seasons adapt the original game's accompanying manga under the titles Episode of Heartslabyul , Episode of Savanaclaw , and Episode of Octavinelle . The anime's English dub debuted on Disney+ and Hulu on the same day the anime premiered.

The main cast for the first season, Episode of Heartslabyul , includes these returning cast members from the main game:

• Natsuki Hanae as Riddle Rosehearts

• Seiichirō Yamashita as Ace Trappola

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Deuce Spade

• Ryōta Suzuki as Trey Clover

• Tatsuyuki Kobayashi as Cater Diamond

• Noriaki Sugiyama as Grim

• Mitsuru Miyamoto as Dire Crowley

Kenyū Horiuchi voices Dark Mirror, and Kento Hama voices Che'nya in the anime. Other cast members are:

• Octavinelle Dorm: Atsushi Tamaru as Azul Ashengrotto Wataru Komada as Jade Leech Nobuhiko Okamoto as Floyd Leech

• Scarabia Dorm: Kazuki Furuta as Kalim Al-Asim Kaname Futaba as Jamil Viper

• Pomefiore Dorm Hiroki Aiba as Vil Schoenheit Shimba Tsuchiya as Epel Felmier Yōjirō Itokawa as Rook Hunt

• Ignihyde Dorm Kōki Uchiyama as Idia Shroud Shōta Aoi as Ortho Shroud

• Diasomnia Dorm Kazuki Katō as Malleus Draconia Hikaru Midorikawa as Lilia Vanrouge Nobunaga Shimazaki as Silver Haruki Ishiya as Sebek Zigvolt

• Night Raven College Staff Kento Itō as Divus Crewel Rikiya Koyama as Mozus Trein Ryōta Takeuchi as Ashton Vargas Subaru Kimura as Sam

Takahiro Natori ( Aria the Benedizione , Tokyo Mew Mew New ) is serving as chief director and series script supervisor, and Shin Katagai ( The Ossan Newbie Adventurer ) is directing at Yumeta Company and Graphinica . Yoichi Kato ( Space Brothers , Aikatsu! ) is credited as the main writer. Hanaka Nakano and Akane Satō are designing the characters.

Takumi Ozawa , the composer of the game, is also composing the music in the anime itself.

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film's Sequel Confrmed
content:
The staff for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film confirmed on Tuesday that it will receive a sequel. The staff also announced that the film has sold 301,630 tickets for 516,132,800 yen (about US$3.24 million) over its first four days. (Monday was a Japanese holiday, Labor Thanksgiving Day.)

The film features a returning cast:

• Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki

• Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki

The staff members are:

• Director: Masashi Takeuchi

• Character Design: Moe Tsuzuki

• Chief Animation Director: Masato Nagamori

• Script Production: ufotable

• Sub-Character Design: Nana Ishigo, Masato Nagamori

• Prop Design: Masato Saitō

• Compositing Director of Photography/Finishing Technical Director: Yuichi Terao

• 3D Director: Gōchū Satō

• Art Director: Koji Eto

• Color Key Artist: Mika Matsuoka

• Editing: Manabu Kamino

• Music: Hideyuki Fukasawa

• Chief Director: Hikaru Kondo

The film opened on regular and IMAX screens in Japan on November 20. The original visual novel game's smartphone version launched on the same day as the film's opening in Japan. The film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27. In particular, the anime studio ufotable produced about 981 updated shots, or 67 minutes and six seconds of the film's 129-minute runtime, for the footage projected onto the two side screens for the Screen X release.

Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the film in the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch versions of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-, the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PS4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

title: All You Need Is Kill, Kaguya!, Grotesqqque, More Anime Confirmed Eligible for Oscars
content:
The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences announced the films eligible for consideration for the 99th Annual Academy Awards in the Animated Feature, International Feature, and Documentary Feature categories on Monday.

Among the 38 titles eligible for the Animated Feature category, the anime films and Japanese media-related films are:

• Director Kenichiro Akimoto and STUDIO 4°C's All You Need Is Kill

• Director Shingo Yamashita and Studio Chromato, Studio Colorido's Cosmic Princess Kaguya!

• Director Atsushi Nishigori and studio CloverWorks' Grotesqqque

• Director Ryūya Suzuki's Jinsei

• Director Baku Kinoshita and studio CLAP's The Last Blossom

• Director Shūkō Murase and studio Sunrise's Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe

• Director Yūki Igarashi and studio OUTLINE's The Ribbon Hero

Additionally, Nintendo , Illumination, and Universal Pictures ' The Super Mario Galaxy Movie and Paramount Pictures ' Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender are also eligible. Japan's submission for the International Feature is All of a Sudden ( Kyū ni Guai ga Waruku Naru ).

Some of these films still need to play in at least one commercial theater in one of six major American metropolitan areas for at least one straight week before December 31, to fully qualify for consideration.

In related news, IndieWire reported on Monday that Gods Don't Give Gifts , an upcoming film entirely made with generative AI from director Zack London (also known as YouTuber Gossip Goblin) was deemed ineligible for the Best Animated Feature category of the 99th Oscars. According to the report, the Academy's Animation Branch Executive Committee may have determined that Gods Don't Give Gifts did not meet the Academy's definition of an animated film under its rules.

The Academy Awards defines an animated feature film:

An animated film is one in which characters or objects are given the illusion of life by having movement created for them, by any human means. While the crucial movement of a live-action motion picture is captured at speed, animation is the craft of human creation and manipulation of images to produce a performance from inanimate objects. At least 75 percent of the motion picture's running time, without opening or end credits, must include animation of the primary subject or subjects. An animated feature film has a running time of more than 40 minutes. Upon submission, filmmakers must provide information supporting how the motion picture qualifies as an animated film.

London and the film's producer Edward Saatchi stated to IndieWire that they plan to appeal the decision. The film's staff still plans a theatrical run starting on December 4, which would otherwise be a qualifying run for the Oscars.

The 99th Academy Awards will hold preliminary voting for select categories from December 7 to December 11. The academy will then announce the shortlists of qualifying films in certain categories on December 15, and announce the nominations on January 21.

The 99th Academy Awards ceremony will take place at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood on March 14.

Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli 's The Boy and the Heron won the Best Animated Feature category in the 96th Academy Awards in 2024. Takashi Yamazaki and TOHO 's Godzilla Minus One also won Best Visual Effects.

Toei Animation , Daisuke Nishio , and Takashi Washio 's "Magic Candies" ("Amedama") short received a nomination for Best Animated Short Film in the 97th Academy Awards held this past March, but did not win the award.

title: 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Sequel Anime Announced
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the anime movie adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel announced on Tuesday that a sequel anime is in production.

Produced by ufotable , Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) theatrical movie premiered in Japan on November 20 and is currently screening in theaters, grossing over 526.13 million yen (approximately US$3.4 million) in its first four days.

Developed and published by Type-Moon, the visual novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) was launched for Windows in Japan in April 2012. An enhanced remaster debuted on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 in December 2022, followed by a Steam port in December 2023. It later received a worldwide release in December 2023. Written by Kinoko Nasu , it serves as a prequel to Shingetsutan Tsukihime ( Lunar Legend Tsukihime ) within the shared Nasuverse.

ufotable—the animation studio behind the Kara no Kyoukai ( The Garden of Sinners ) film series and Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel trilogy—is producing the film. Type-Moon and Kinoko Nasu ( Fate/stay night , Shingetsutan Tsukihime ) are credited for the original work.

Synopsis Set near the end of the Showa period in the late 1980s, an old mansion in Misaki Town is rumored to be the home of a witch.

Aoko abruptly enters the world of magi after her grandfather suddenly decides to have Aoko become the Aozaki family's successor. Since then, Aoko moves into the Kuonji Mansion and begins to learn magecraft from the young magus Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. After witnessing the two using magecraft, Soujuurou Shizuki is also forced to live with them until a rune to remove his memories is discovered. (Source: Type-Moon Fandom Wiki)

title: Getbackers Voice Comic Staff Apologizes for Generative AI Use in PR Video
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the voice comic of Yūya Aoki and Rando Ayamine 's Getbackers manga apologized to fans for the use of generative AI in a promotional video last week, and the resulting misunderstanding, confusion, and worry among fans. (The voice comic project adds an audio track for dialogue and sound effects to existing panels from the manga.)

The apology post explained that the video was only announcing the continuation of the voice comic, which had been on hiatus for almost 10 months. The post added that the use of generative AI in the video, and the lack of disclosure about how it was used, misled people into thinking that the manga would get a brand-new television anime, or at least that the manga would get a new anime that would use generative AI.

The voice comic's staff still plans to resume the project on December 1, and as with previous episodes, the staff still plans to combine the manga's panels with spoken dialogue by voice actors and sound effects.

The staff emphasizes that they do not plan to use generative AI for processing the source material in the voice comic, and do not plan to use generative AI for animation in the voice comic.

The voice comic's staff also emphasized that their management was entirely responsible for the use of generative AI in the announcement promotional video, and that manga's original publisher Kodansha played no role in that decision. The staff added that they will refrain from animating future announcement videos and promotional videos with generative AI that would cause similar misunderstandings. The staff will strengthen its vetting process on production content and presentation.

The manga follows the adventures of Ban and Ginji, two young men who hire themselves out to "get back" things that people have lost.

Aoki and Ayamine debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 1999, and ended it in February 2007. The manga had 39 compiled book volumes. Tokyopop once published the manga before losing the rights in 2009.

The manga inspired a 49-episode anime series that premiered in 2002, with an American release by ADV Films following in 2004. Sentai Filmworks then licensed the anime.

Thank you to Kan2Screm for the news tip.

title: Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara Anime's Video Unveils Cast
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Kengo Matsumoto 's Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta. (When I Tried to Get Payback Against My Hometown Bullies, Another Battle Began) manga (nicknamed "Ijihaji" for short) announced the show's main four cast members over the last four days, and presented a promotional video on Tuesday.

The anime stars:

• Kaori Maeda as Akira Mikazuki, a wrestling genius (pictured at right in visual below)

• Yūko Natsuyoshi as Kanae Oborozuki, a basketball genius (center)

• Lynn as Shigure Mangetsu, a gaming master (left)

• Rikuya Yasuda as the protagonist Kotarō Hinode

The "new type of misunderstanding battle romantic comedy" manga centers on Kotarō Hinode, who when he was young was constantly humiliated in wrestling, basketball, and games by three children named Akira, Kanae, and Shigure, respectively. Now in high school, Kotarō vows to get back at them, and returns to his hometown. However, it turns out Akira, Kanae, and Shigure were not boys like Kotarō thought, but were girls. And now these three girls are young women who look like a gyaru, rich girl, and beautiful girl. In addition, all three start treating him kindly.

Chihiro Kumano ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight , The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei ) is directing the series at studio Gekkō . Kazuho Hyōdō ( TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You , ReLIFE ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Yūsaku Nakamura ( Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is designing the characters.

The anime will debut in 2027.

Matsumoto launched the manga in March 2023 on the " Suiyōbi no Sirius " platform on Nico Nico Seiga . Kodansha will publish the 10th compiled volume on December 9.

Tokyopop is publishing Matsumoto's My New Wife's Fake Smile manga in English, and Kodansha USA Publishing has released Matsumoto's How to Treat a Lady Knight Right manga in English.

title: Psyren TV Anime Adds 6 Cast Members
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced more cast members for the anime on Monday.

The newly announced cast members are (from left to right in image above):

• Takaya Kuroda as Kagetora Hyōdō

• Wataru Komada as Ian

• Mutsumi Tamura as Kyle Tenjuin

• Mitsuki Saiga as Shao Tenjuin

• Ayana Taketatsu as Frederica Tenjuin

• Kana Ichinose as Marie Tenjuin

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psy ren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

Katsumi Ono ( Symphogear AXZ , Symphogear G , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Naruto Shippūden , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! GX ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Akira Ōkuma ( Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ; Demon Lord, Retry! R ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Takashi Ōmama ( Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , I Parry Everything ), and Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses ).

CLAN QUEEN performs the opening theme song "Warning!!" Who-ya Extended performs the ending theme song "ICARUS."

REMOW stated the anime will fully adapt the manga through its conclusion.

The anime premiered on October 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Global Stage Hollywood screened the world premiere for the second episode of the anime at the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival on October 3 at the Chinese Theater in Hollywood, California. The first episode also screened its West Coast premiere during the event. The manga's original creator Iwashiro was in attendance at the screening.

Iwashiro serialized Psyren in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2007-2010. Viz Media released all 16 volumes in English from 2011 to 2014.

title: Manga Creator Tsukasa Sei Dies
content:
Manga creator Tsukasa Sei died on November 17. Sei's official X (formerly Twitter ) account announced the death on November 20.

Sei launched the Mukashi wa Yokatta (It Was Good Back Then) manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app in February 2023, and ended it in September of that year.
